_what_this_is: Deliberate defects injected into REAL source, one at a time, restored with git. Each
must make the gate go red. One that escapes is a class of bug that can currently
merge into the Virtual Agent with nobody reading the diff.
This is the ONLY thing in the gate that measures the HARNESS rather than the code.
Until one of these has been injected and caught there is no evidence any check here
THIS FILE IS PROTECTED. A builder that can edit its own defect set can pass it.
_archetypes_covered: an invariant raised out of range     -> cap-raised-to-1000, window-shrunk-to-an-hour
an output made constant              -> source-is-always-wiki, arabic-never-detected
a live property quietly dropped      -> sentences-only-at-the-end
Every defect is TYPE-CLEAN and LINT-CLEAN on purpose. A mutation that ruff or mypy
catches has measured the compiler, not the harness. They aim at MISSION hard
invariants 1 through 5 and at the one property the requirement calls 'live'.
_written: 2026-09-04, the day after the holdout, against the first implementation.

defects.why: MISSION hard invariant 5 is a specific number, not 'there is a limit'. Every unit test reads the constant symbolically and keeps passing; only a check that knows the number can see it moved. Ten times the inference budget, silently.
The same invariant from the other side: a cap per hour instead of per day is a cap 24 times larger. Still a limit, still enforced, still wrong.

MISSION hard invariant 1. A fifth language with no voice, no greeting and no detection is the exact shape a well-meaning issue would leave behind. Type-clean: a frozenset of strings is a frozenset of strings.
An output made constant for one of the four: Arabic script can never reach a ratio above one, so Arabic clients are asked, forever, to continue in a supported language. Everything else keeps working.

MISSION hard invariant 2, inverted. Every question the wiki covers now goes to the web and every question it does not cover is composed from unrelated excerpts. Both paths still return an answer with a declared source, so nothing crashes.

MISSION hard invariant 3. A web answer labelled as a wiki answer is the product lying about where it got its answer, which is the one thing the PRD says the product is. Type-clean: a non-empty string is truthy.

defects.find:
async def read_session(session: Session = Depends(get_current_session)) -> dict[str, object]:
    return session.to_dict()
defects.why: A guard removed. MISSION hard invariant 4: anyone with a session id can now read its transcript. The route still 404s on unknown ids and still returns the right shape, so it looks finished. Only a check that walks the assembled app, or actually tries another token, can see it.

The requirement's word is 'live'. With this, no sentence event fires until the whole reply has streamed, so the app speaks nothing until the end. Every token still arrives, the final flush still emits the last sentence, the turn still closes. Type-clean: a slice of a list is a list.
